name: Little Crow
rangeDescription: Inland australia (reaching coasts in west and south)
description: Australian crows and ravens are challenging to identify; concentrate on call, throat-hackles, behavior, and location. Calls usually a very fairly short, repeated “ah-ah-ah.” Note relatively short bill, white bases to the small throat hackles.

name: Dwarf Vireo
rangeDescription: Arid highlands of southwestern mexico (southeastern jalisco to oaxaca)
description: Small, relatively active vireo of scrubby woodlands and brushy thickets in highlands; mainly in areas of oak woodland. Endemic to southwestern Mexico.

name: Purple-crowned Lorikeet
rangeDescription: Semiarid lowlands of southwestern and southeastern australia, including kangaroo island
description: Small green lorikeet with pale blue underparts. Note orange and yellow check patch, purple crown, yellow above the bill, and red patches in front of the eyes.

name: Somali Bunting
rangeDescription: Sudan to ethiopia, somalia, uganda, kenya, and northeastern tanzania
description: A beautiful bunting of dry country. Note the black-and-white facial pattern, the gray back with russet streaks, the gray rump, and the yellow breast with pale sides.

name: Sooty Myzomela
rangeDescription: Makira and santa ana (southeastern solomon islands)
description: Silky black with a slight bluish-green tinge to the wing and tail feathers when seen in direct sunlight. Juvenile has a distinctive fleshy yellow bill, tipped black.

name: Plumbeous-crowned Tyrannulet
rangeDescription: Andes of colombia to ecuador and southern peru (cusco)
description: Small uncommon flycatcher in the subtropical zone of the Andes from Colombia to Peru. It has a pale yellow belly, gray crown, dark ear patch, and yellow edges on the wing feathers.

name: White-bearded Flycatcher
rangeDescription: Llanos of venezuela
description: Fluffy and chubby, a short-billed version of a kiskadee. Black crown and mask, puffy white throat, and broad white eyebrow that connects on the back of head.

name: Ross's Goose
rangeDescription: Breeds tundra of arctic north-central canada; winters to western and central usa and central mexico
description: Cute miniature version of Snow Goose with smaller body, shorter neck, and stubbier bill. Pay special attention to the bill: short, with a straighter border where it meets the face, a much less obvious dark “grin patch,” and often bluish-gray color at the base.

name: Nuku Hiva Imperial-Pigeon
rangeDescription: Nukuhiva island (marquesas islands)
description: A large pigeon with a mostly dark gray body and a greenish back and wings. Head appears elongated, with a fleshy saddle at the base of the bill.

name: Chestnut-flanked White-eye
rangeDescription: Southeastern siberia to southwestern china and northeastern manchuria; winters to southeastern asia
description: The most migratory of the Asian white-eyes, this minute bird breeds in the boreal woodlands of far northeastern China and Russia and winters in southern China and northern Southeast Asia. Frequently migrates in immense flocks and can often be seen in gatherings of thousands on headlands and islands.

name: Black-belted Flowerpecker
rangeDescription: Philippines (panay and negros); probably extinct on guimaras
description: A small bird of forest and fairly open woodland from the lowlands to lower elevations in the mountains. Black above, glossed blue, with white underparts marked by a red patch from the chest to the belly, bordered with black around the top.

name: Chattering Cisticola
rangeDescription: Nigeria to cameroon, gabon, congo, democratic republic of the congo, and northwestern angola
description: A common, nondescript bird found near the ground in grassy areas in fields, in towns, along roads, and even in larger treefall gaps in lowland rainforest. Small and warbler-like, with a white throat, dingy white underparts, a brownish red cap, and brownish upperparts.
imageCreditName: Lars Petersson | My World of Bird Photography

name: Caucasian Snowcock
rangeDescription: Rocky high-montane caucasus of southwestern russia, northern georgia, and northern azerbaijan
description: Large and heavily-built gamebird of the Caucasus Mountains. Grayish overall, with a whitish face and throat.

name: Masked Saltator
rangeDescription: Andes of far southeastern colombia to northeastern peru
description: Rare and beautiful bird of high Andean cloud forest, at least in some places found especially in bamboo. Very distinctive with black breast band, face, and throat, mostly red bill, yellow eye, and white tail tips.

name: Black-bellied Tern
rangeDescription: Pakistan, nepal, and india to southwestern china, myanmar, and southeastern asia
description: Elegant tern with a long tail and a slender orange bill. Breeding adult has a full black cap and dark belly.

name: Tacarcuna Wood-Quail
rangeDescription: Far eastern panama and adjacent northwestern colombia (chocó)
description: This rare chickenlike bird has an exceptionally small range on the border between Panama and Colombia. Found on the ground in mature forest from around 1,000–1,400 m.

name: Torresian Imperial-Pigeon
rangeDescription: New guinea, including aru islands (off southwestern new guinea) and adjacent islands, to northern and northeastern australia
description: Large, predominantly white pigeon with black wing feathers. Tip of the tail also black.

name: Morrison's Fulvetta
rangeDescription: Taiwan
description: Active small songbird, endemic to Taiwan. Brown above, white below, with gray head, large white eyering, thin black borders in crown (hard to see at times), and buffy wash in flanks.

name: Little Crow
rangeDescription: Inland australia (reaching coasts in west and south)
description: Australian crows and ravens are challenging to identify; concentrate on call, throat-hackles, behavior, and location. Calls usually a very fairly short, repeated “ah-ah-ah.” Note relatively short bill, white bases to the small throat hackles.

name: Rwenzori Apalis
rangeDescription: Montane forest of eastern democratic republic of the congo, southwestern uganda, rwanda, and burundi
description: Slim, pretty, long-tailed member of the cisticola family that sports gray upperparts and buffy underparts with a black chest band. Common in montane forest of the Albertine Rift.
